pay_salary_schedule_001.evidence: There will be a Grandfathered Salary Schedule and a Performance Salary Schedule in accordance with s. 1012.22 F.S. The 2018-2019 salary schedule for instructional staff The annual salary for members of this bargaining unit shall be set forth in Appendices _____A through ___.A2 as follows:

pay_salary_schedule_002.evidence: The 2018-2019 salary schedule for instructional staff... The 2015-2016 Grandfathered Salary Schedule includes one step advancement for all eligible teachers.

pay_step_increment_003.evidence: incremental steps on the salary schedule are subject to renegotiations every year and are not automatically payable until such time as a new salary schedule has been ratified. The 2015-2016 Grandfathered Salary Schedule includes one step advancement for all eligible teachers. Florida Statutes prohibits salary adjustments based on experience for teachers on the Performance Salary Schedule. Therefore, there is no step advancement on the Performance Salary Schedule.

pay_prior_experience_005.evidence: ARTICLE 46745 CREDIT FOR PRIOR SERVICE ON SALARY SCHEDULE... Credit on the instructional salary schedule will be granted for all verified public school experience in accordance with state law.

pay_performance_pay_006.evidence: It shall be the responsibility of the principal or other designated agent of the Board to recommend, on an annual basis, those individuals who are to receive salary supplements... The supplemental compensation is available for additional responsibilities related to academics, athletics, fine arts and other activities
pay_performance_pay_006.coder_notes: The quoted evidence describes supplemental compensation for additional responsibilities, not an explicit statement regarding the presence or absence of performance, merit, or evaluation-based compensation. Changed to discussed_unclear per audit criteria.

pay_performance_pay_007.answer: Performance-based bonuses are tied to school letter grade improvement (e.g., improving to a C or better, or improving by two letter grades) rather than individual teacher evaluations.
pay_performance_pay_007.evidence: When the grade assigned to a Tier III or Tier IV School improves to C or better, a teacher who worked at the school that year will receive a performance bonus equal to $1,500. If the grade assigned to a Tier III or Tier IV School improves by two letter grades, the teacher who worked at the school that year will receive a performance bonus equal to $2,000.
